correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all four rational-canonical GL_2 conjugacy cases: scalar (one identity d=8, other scalars d=0), Jordan unipotent (d=4 exactly in characteristic 2, else d=3), split semisimple (tensor eigenvalue multiplicities 3,3,1,1; directed squaring and cubic-root exception), and irreducible quadratic semisimple (exactly one d=2 class when q is 2 mod 3). Similarity-class cardinalities are 1, q^2−1, q(q+1), q(q−1). Their weighted sum produces the posted six N_k(q) formula for every prime power. Independent direct rank computation over GF(2),GF(3),GF(4),GF(5),GF(7) exhaustively enumerated GL_2 and matched N_k and group orders; these finite cases corroborate rather than establish the all-q theorem.
